Today we’re releasing OpenWork Connect. OpenWork started as a free, open-source desktop app. The goal was to make the fully configured agent experience I had in OpenCode available to coworkers who did not want to set up repositories, copy configuration files, or learn a new developer tool. But we tried to put too much into one app. The person building workflows and the person using them often need completely different interfaces. OpenWork Connect separates those two experiences.
